The conclusion leads; structure carries the explanation; colour only means something. */
:root{color-scheme:light;--paper:#f4f5f7;--panel:#fff;--surface:#fff;--sunk:#f6f7f9;--zebra:#f8f9fa;--ink:#111318;--secondary:#2c3038;--muted:#6a707c;--faint:#9aa0aa;--rule:#e5e7eb;--rule-strong:#d3d7dd;--accent:#2457d6;--accent-soft:#eaf0fd;--accent-ink:#1b46b4;--marker:#dbe6fd;--good:#13834b;--good-soft:#e8f5ee;--caution:#b26a00;--caution-soft:#fdf3e2;--bad:#c4321f;--bad-soft:#fcebe8;--violet:#6a4fc8;--violet-soft:#f0ecfb;--code:#f6f7f9;--badge:#111318;--badge-ink:#fff;--shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40/.04),0 1px 3px rgb(16 24 40/.03);--sans:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif;--mono:"SF Mono",ui-monospace,"JetBrains Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace}
:root[data-theme=dark]{color-scheme:dark;--paper:#0c0d10;--panel:#15171c;--surface:#15171c;--sunk:#1b1e24;--zebra:#191c21;--ink:#f1f3f6;--secondary:#cfd3da;--muted:#8d94a1;--faint:#5f6672;--rule:#262a31;--rule-strong:#343943;--accent:#7aa2ff;--accent-soft:#18223a;--accent-ink:#a3bfff;--marker:#24345c;--good:#5cc98d;--good-soft:#122a1e;--caution:#e9b04f;--caution-soft:#2e2412;--bad:#f2806f;--bad-soft:#331a17;--violet:#a994f5;--violet-soft:#221d36;--code:#1b1e24;--badge:#f1f3f6;--badge-ink:#111318;--shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.35)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme]){color-scheme:dark;--paper:#0c0d10;--panel:#15171c;--surface:#15171c;--sunk:#1b1e24;--zebra:#191c21;--ink:#f1f3f6;--secondary:#cfd3da;--muted:#8d94a1;--faint:#5f6672;--rule:#262a31;--rule-strong:#343943;--accent:#7aa2ff;--accent-soft:#18223a;--accent-ink:#a3bfff;--marker:#24345c;--good:#5cc98d;--good-soft:#122a1e;--caution:#e9b04f;--caution-soft:#2e2412;--bad:#f2806f;--bad-soft:#331a17;--violet:#a994f5;--violet-soft:#221d36;--code:#1b1e24;--badge:#f1f3f6;--badge-ink:#111318;--shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.35)}}

/* Base */
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--secondary);font:14.5px/1.72 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;font-feature-settings:"kern"}
h1,h2,h3,p,ul,ol,dl,dd,figure{margin:0}
strong,b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel);padding:4px 11px;line-height:1.5}
button:hover{border-color:var(--faint);color:var(--ink)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}
code,pre{font-family:var(--mono)}
code{font-size:.86em;background:var(--code);border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:0 5px;border-radius:5px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:var(--ink);-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone}
::selection{background:var(--marker)}
.interactive{display:none!important}
.js .interactive{display:initial!important}
.skip-link{position:absolute;top:-80px;left:12px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);z-index:10}
.skip-link:focus{top:8px}
.fine{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65}

/* Page frame */
.shell{width:min(1280px,calc(100% - 64px));margin:auto}
.masthead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:32px;padding:36px 0 22px}
h1{font:700 26px/1.35 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.015em;max-width:900px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
/* Toolbar: one height, one radius, one type size for every control */
.js .tools{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0}
.tools button{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1;color:var(--secondary)}
.tools :focus{outline:none}
.tools :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.tool-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:30px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,var(--rule-strong));border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgb(16 24 40/.03);transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,color .15s}
.tool-button:hover{background:var(--sunk);color:var(--ink)}
.tool-button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:progress}
.tool-icon{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.tool-button .tool-icon{color:var(--muted)}
.tool-button:hover .tool-icon{color:var(--ink)}
.theme-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;height:30px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,var(--rule-strong));border-radius:8px;padding:2px;gap:2px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgb(16 24 40/.03)}
.theme-controls button{height:24px;border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:0 10px;background:none;color:var(--muted)}
.theme-controls button:hover{color:var(--ink);background:var(--sunk)}
.theme-controls button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--sunk);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule)}
.tool-menu{position:relative}
/* The same control shape for the walk-through bar, its start buttons and the question dialog */
.walk-bar button,.walk-start:not(.text-button),.ask-dialog footer button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,var(--rule-strong));border-radius:8px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1}
.ask-dialog footer button{height:32px;padding:0 14px}
.tool-menu [aria-haspopup] .tool-icon:last-child{width:13px;height:13px;margin-left:1px;transition:transform .15s}
.tool-menu [aria-expanded=true] .tool-icon:last-child{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.style-swatch{width:14px;height:14px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0/.12)}
.style-swatch[data-swatch=clean]{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f4f5f7 50%,#2457d6 50%)}
.style-swatch[data-swatch=editorial]{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f6f2ea 50%,#9c2f1f 50%)}
.style-swatch[data-swatch=product]{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1efff 50%,#5b4bf5 50%)}
.style-swatch[data-swatch=swiss]{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 50%,#ff4f00 50%)}
.menu-options{position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 6px);z-index:40;min-width:148px;padding:4px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--control-border,var(--rule-strong));border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgb(16 24 40/.14)}
.menu-options button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;width:100%;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:none;text-align:left}
.menu-options button span:not(.style-swatch){flex:1}
.menu-options button:hover,.menu-options button:focus-visible{background:var(--sunk);outline:none;color:var(--ink)}
.style-options .tool-icon{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--accent);visibility:hidden}
.style-options [aria-checked=true]{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.style-options [aria-checked=true] .tool-icon{visibility:visible}
.export-menu .menu-options{min-width:176px}
.export-menu .menu-options .tool-icon{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.export-menu .menu-options small{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)}
.menu-label{padding:6px 10px 2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.02em}
.menu-options hr{margin:4px 6px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}

/* Board */
.board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;align-items:stretch}
.board.measuring{display:block}
.board.measured{grid-auto-rows:1px;row-gap:0}
.board.measured>.board-spacer{display:none}
.span1{grid-column:span 1}.span2{grid-column:span 2}.span3{grid-column:span 3}.span4{grid-column:span 4}.span5{grid-column:span 5}.span6{grid-column:span 6}.span7{grid-column:span 7}.span8{grid-column:span 8}.span9{grid-column:span 9}.span10{grid-column:span 10}.span11{grid-column:span 11}.span12{grid-column:span 12}
.board-spacer{min-width:0}
.panel{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:clip;overflow-clip-margin:4px}
.panel-head{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:13px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.panel-id{flex-shrink:0;min-width:22px;height:22px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:6px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--badge);color:var(--badge-ink);font:600 12px/1 var(--sans);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-decoration:none}
.panel-id:hover{text-decoration:none;background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.panel-head h2{font:600 15.5px/1.45 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.panel-body{padding:16px 20px 20px;flex:1}
.block{position:relative;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.block+.block{margin-top:16px}
.block>p+p{margin-top:8px}

/* Conclusion: the same card, read first. One quiet tinted box carries the verdict. */
.answer-id{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
:root[data-theme=dark] .answer-id{color:#0c0d10}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme]) .answer-id{color:#0c0d10}}
.verdict{padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent-soft);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent);font:600 17px/1.65 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.005em;text-wrap:pretty}
.verdict strong{font-weight:700;color:var(--accent-ink)}
.reasons{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:14px 0 0;counter-reset:reason}
.reasons li{counter-increment:reason;position:relative;padding:5px 0 5px 26px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--secondary)}
.reasons li::before{content:counter(reason);position:absolute;left:2px;top:9px;width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--muted);background:var(--sunk);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-strong)}
/* A full-width conclusion sets the verdict beside its reasons instead of in one long line. */
.answer-panel{container-type:inline-size}
@container (min-width:900px){.answer-panel .panel-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:28px;align-items:start}.answer-panel .reasons{margin-top:-5px}}
.answer-scope{padding:10px 20px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted)}
.scope-label{flex-shrink:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);margin-right:2px}
.scope-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--sunk);border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--secondary);font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}

/* Text */
.block-prose>p{color:var(--secondary)}
.text-list{list-style:none;padding:0}
.text-list li{position:relative;padding-left:16px}
.text-list li+li{margin-top:6px}
ul.text-list li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:.72em;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink);opacity:.55}
ol.text-list{counter-reset:item}
ol.text-list li{counter-increment:item;padding-left:24px}
ol.text-list li::before{content:counter(item) ".";position:absolute;left:0;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.checklist{list-style:none;padding:0}
.checklist li+li{border-top:1px dashed var(--rule)}
.checklist label{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:7px 0;cursor:pointer}
.checklist input{appearance:none;flex-shrink:0;width:17px;height:17px;margin:3px 0 0;border:1.5px solid var(--rule-strong);border-radius:5px;background:var(--panel);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}
.checklist input::after{content:"";width:5px;height:9px;margin-top:-2px;border:solid var(--panel);border-width:0 2px 2px 0;transform:rotate(45deg) scale(0);transition:transform .12s}
.checklist input:checked{background:var(--good);border-color:var(--good)}
.checklist input:checked::after{transform:rotate(45deg) scale(1)}
.checklist input:checked+span{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:var(--faint)}
.callout{padding:11px 16px;background:var(--sunk);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--faint);color:var(--secondary)}
.callout h3{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:2px}
.callout.warning{background:var(--caution-soft);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--caution)}
.callout.open-question{background:var(--violet-soft);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--violet)}
.cite{vertical-align:super;font-size:10px;line-height:0;margin-left:1px}
.cite a{font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);padding:0 1px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cite a:hover{text-decoration:none;background:var(--accent-soft);border-radius:3px}

/* Comparison */
.table-scroll{overflow:auto}
table{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;width:100%;font-size:13.5px}
th,td{padding:9px 12px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
thead th{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);padding-top:2px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);white-space:nowrap}
tbody tr:nth-child(even)>*{background:var(--zebra)}
tbody tr:nth-child(even)>:first-child{border-radius:6px 0 0 6px}
tbody tr:nth-child(even)>:last-child{border-radius:0 6px 6px 0}
th[scope=row]{width:24%;min-width:96px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);font-size:13.5px}
td{min-width:112px;color:var(--secondary)}
.assessment{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:600}
.assessment b{color:inherit;font-weight:600}
.assessment::before{flex-shrink:0;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 10px/1 var(--sans);color:#fff}
.assessment.good{color:var(--good)}.assessment.good::before{content:"✓";background:var(--good)}
.assessment.caution{color:var(--caution)}.assessment.caution::before{content:"!";background:var(--caution)}
.assessment.bad{color:var(--bad)}.assessment.bad::before{content:"✕";background:var(--bad)}
:root[data-theme=dark] .assessment::before{color:#0c0d10}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme]) .assessment::before{color:#0c0d10}}
.assessment-meter{display:none}
.cell-text{display:block;color:var(--secondary);line-height:1.6}
.assessment+.cell-text{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:2px}

/* Facts and metrics */
.facts>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(80px,1fr) minmax(0,2fr);gap:16px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.facts>div:first-child{padding-top:0}
.facts>div:last-child{border-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
.facts dt{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.facts dd{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.metric-label{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.metric-value{font:700 32px/1.25 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);margin:4px 0;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.metric-value span,.metric-value small{font:500 14px var(--sans);margin-left:5px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0}
meter{width:100%;height:8px;accent-color:var(--accent)}
.metric-over-limit .metric-value,.metric-overflow{color:var(--bad)}
.metric-overflow{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-top:6px}
.typical,.chip{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong);padding:0 6px;font-size:10.5px;border-radius:4px;color:var(--muted)}
.typical{margin:5px 0}
.typical-ref{font-size:10px;display:inline-block;min-width:16px;text-align:center}
.text-button{border:0;background:none;padding:0;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent)}
.text-button:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}

/* Steps: a numbered rail */
.steps{list-style:none;padding:0;counter-reset:step}
.steps li{counter-increment:step;position:relative;padding:0 0 16px 36px}
.steps li:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.steps li::before{content:counter(step);position:absolute;left:0;top:1px;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 11.5px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);background:var(--panel);border:1.5px solid var(--rule-strong);z-index:1;transition:background .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s}
.steps li:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:11px;top:25px;bottom:3px;width:1.5px;background:var(--rule)}
.steps b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink)}
.steps p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
/* Text linked to a diagram node, and the step-through controls */
.term{text-decoration:underline dotted color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 55%,transparent);text-underline-offset:3px;text-decoration-thickness:1.5px;border-radius:3px;transition:background .15s}
.term:hover,.term.term-lit{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-ink);text-decoration-color:var(--accent)}
.walk-start{margin-bottom:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 35%,var(--rule))}
.walk-start[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent-soft)}
.js .walk-start[hidden]{display:none!important}
.walk-bar{position:sticky;top:8px;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0 0 12px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:10px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--panel) 92%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);font-size:12px}
.walk-text{flex:1 1 220px;min-width:0;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px}
.walk-text:empty{display:none}
.walk-bar button{font-size:12px;padding:2px 10px}
.walk-count{min-width:44px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.steps li.walk-current::before{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.steps li.walk-current b,.steps li.walk-current .diagram-link{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.steps li:not(.walk-current):has(~ .walk-current) b,.steps:has(.walk-current) li:not(.walk-current) p{opacity:.55}
.diagram-link{color:var(--ink)}
.diagram-link>span{color:var(--faint);font-weight:400;transition:color .15s}
.diagram-link:hover{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none}
.diagram-link:hover>span{color:var(--accent)}
.steps li:has(.diagram-link):hover::before,.steps li:has(.diagram-link:focus-visible)::before{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.steps li:hover .diagram-link,.steps li:hover .diagram-link>span{color:var(--accent)}
.steps li:has(.diagram-link):hover p{color:var(--secondary)}

/* Diagram preview: native SVG re-tinted and re-typeset to the page */
.diagram-panel .panel-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:14px 16px 16px}
.block-diagram{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.diagram{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.diagram-preview{flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;padding:0}
.diagram-preview>svg{display:block;width:min(100%,calc(var(--native-width,100vw) * 1.25))!important;margin-inline:auto;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;max-width:none!important}
.diagram-preview>svg>rect[fill^="url("],.diagram-preview [data-legend]{display:none}
/* A single lane is the whole diagram, and lanes the shorthand adds only to stack branches carry no
   meaning: the caption names the diagram, so their frames and numbered labels are noise. */
.bare-lanes rect[data-composition-frame-kind=lane],.bare-lanes rect[data-composition-frame-kind=lane]+text{display:none}
/* Phase labels then sit just above the nodes instead of above the hidden lane header. */
.single-lane .phase-rule,.single-lane .phase-chip,.single-lane .phase-chip+text{transform:translateY(30px)}
.diagram-preview text{font-family:var(--sans)!important}
.board .diagram-preview.diagram-preview[class]{--bg:transparent;--lane-fill:color-mix(in srgb,var(--sunk) 55%,transparent);--lane-stroke:var(--control-border,var(--rule-strong));--grid:transparent;--canvas-dot:transparent;--mask:var(--surface);--panel:var(--surface);--text:var(--ink);--text-muted:var(--muted);--text-dim:var(--muted);--text-faint:var(--faint);--arrow:var(--faint);--arrow-emphasis:var(--accent);--frontend-fill:var(--surface);--frontend-stroke:var(--rule-strong);--backend-fill:var(--accent-soft);--backend-stroke:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 50%,var(--rule));--database-fill:var(--sunk);--database-stroke:var(--rule-strong);--cloud-fill:var(--surface);--cloud-stroke:var(--rule-strong);--external-fill:var(--surface);--external-stroke:var(--rule-strong);--messagebus-fill:var(--surface);--messagebus-stroke:var(--rule-strong);--security-fill:var(--surface);--security-stroke:var(--rule-strong)}
.diagram-preview .semantic-sigil{color:var(--muted);stroke:var(--muted)}
.diagram-preview text.t-edge-default{fill:var(--accent-ink)}
.diagram-preview [data-node-id],.diagram-preview [data-edge-id]{transition:opacity .18s}
.diagram-preview.focusing [data-node-id]:not(.reader-highlight),.diagram-preview.focusing [data-edge-id]:not(.reader-highlight){opacity:.22}
.diagram-preview [data-node-id].reader-highlight rect:not(.c-mask){stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2}
.diagram-preview [data-edge-id].reader-highlight path{stroke:var(--accent)}
.diagram-preview [data-edge-id].reader-highlight text{fill:var(--accent)}
/* Steps beside the diagram they walk through, text on the left. The reader sets the diagram column
   to the width its text needs; with less than 320px left for the steps, the diagram wraps above
   them. The diagram stays in view while long steps scroll. */
.diagram-panel .guided{flex-flow:row-reverse wrap;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px 36px}
.guided>.guide-figure{flex:1 0 var(--guide-figure,100%);max-width:min(100%,var(--guide-figure-max,100%));min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.guided.beside>.guide-figure{position:sticky;top:12px}
.guided>.guide-text{flex:1 1 320px;min-width:0}
/* The diagram's header: its title, and the way into the interactive view. */
.diagram>figcaption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 12px;min-height:28px;margin:0 0 10px;padding:0 2px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.diagram-title{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--secondary)}
.js .diagram-actions{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-left:auto}
.explore-button{height:28px;padding:0 10px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1;color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 32%,var(--rule))}
.explore-button .tool-icon{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--accent)}
.explore-button:hover{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.diagram>figcaption .walk-start{margin:0}
.js .diagram-preview [data-node-id]{cursor:pointer}
.image figcaption,.code figcaption,.diff figcaption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px;padding:0 4px}
.js .diagram-semantics{display:none}
.diagram-semantics{margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.diagram-semantics ul{padding-left:18px}
.diagram-semantics code,.changes code{font-size:10px}
.diagram-fit-status:not([hidden]){margin-top:6px}
.changes{font-size:11px;margin-top:8px}
.changes dd{margin-top:3px}
.added{color:var(--good)}.removed{color:var(--bad)}.modified{color:var(--caution)}

/* Code and diff */
.chart{margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;--pele-bg:transparent;--pele-fg:var(--ink);--pele-muted:var(--muted);--pele-line:var(--rule-strong);--pele-surface:var(--sunk);--pele-surface-alt:var(--zebra);--pele-border:var(--rule-strong);--pele-accent:var(--accent);--pele-font:var(--sans);--pele-font-mono:var(--mono);--pele-series-1:var(--accent);--pele-series-2:var(--caution);--pele-series-3:var(--good);--pele-series-4:var(--violet);--pele-series-5:var(--bad);--pele-series-6:var(--accent-ink);--pele-series-7:var(--muted);--pele-series-8:var(--faint)}
/* Charts never scale above their native size, so their text stays at the page's small-text size. */
.chart>svg{display:block;width:min(100%,var(--native-width,100vw));height:auto;margin-inline:auto}
.chart figcaption{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px;padding:0 4px}
.snippet{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;background:var(--code);overflow:hidden}
.snippet figcaption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:6px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);background:var(--panel)}
.snippet-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;color:var(--secondary);font-weight:500}
.snippet-language{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);background:none;border:0;padding:0;font-weight:400}
.snippet pre{margin:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:none;padding:12px 14px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink)}
pre{max-width:100%;overflow:auto;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;background:var(--code);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;margin:8px 0 0}
pre code{background:none;border:0;padding:0;white-space:pre;font-size:inherit}
.diff-scroll{overflow:auto;max-width:100%;margin-top:8px;background:var(--code);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px}
.diff-code{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:12px/1.7 var(--mono)}
.diff-code th{font:10px/1.6 var(--sans);color:var(--muted);text-align:left;background:var(--sunk)}
.diff-code th,.diff-code td{padding:0 8px;border:0;vertical-align:top}
.diff-code .diff-line{display:table-row}
.diff-code code{font:inherit;background:none;border:0;padding:0;white-space:pre}
.diff-code .diff-number{width:1%;min-width:36px;text-align:right;user-select:none;color:var(--faint);border-right:1px solid var(--rule)}
.diff-code .added{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--good) 9%,var(--code));color:var(--good)}
.diff-code .removed{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bad) 9%,var(--code));color:var(--bad)}
.diff-code .hunk{color:var(--accent);background:var(--sunk)}
.diff-code .header,.diff-code .no-newline{color:var(--muted)}
.diff-code tbody tr>*,.diff-code tbody tr:hover>*{background:inherit}
.diff-summary{white-space:nowrap}
.image img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:8px}

/* Footer */
footer{padding:28px 0 32px}
.typical-footnotes{padding:0 0 16px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.typical-footnotes h2,.sources h2{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px}
.typical-footnotes ol{padding-left:20px}
.sources{border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:16px}
.sources:has(ol:empty){display:none}
.sources ol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px 32px;padding-left:20px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.sources li{padding-left:4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sources li::marker{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--faint)}
.sources a{color:var(--secondary)}
.sources a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.sources code{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:11px;background:none;border:0;padding:0;color:var(--muted)}
/* Colophon: the maker's mark, then what the reader can check on this page. */
.colophon{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 16px;margin-top:28px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.sources:has(ol:empty)+.colophon,.typical-footnotes+.colophon{margin-top:8px}
.colophon-brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.colophon-brand:hover{text-decoration:none}
.colophon-mark{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule)}
.colophon-mark svg{width:19px;height:auto}
.colophon-words{display:grid;gap:4px;min-width:0}
.colophon-name{font:650 13.5px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.01em;transition:color .15s}
.colophon-brand:hover .colophon-name{color:var(--accent)}
.colophon-tagline{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--muted)}
.colophon-facts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:4px 0;margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.colophon-facts span+span::before{content:"·";margin:0 8px;color:var(--faint)}
@media(max-width:760px){.colophon-facts{margin-left:0}}

/* Source cards */
.diagram-preview .has-source{cursor:help}
.diagram-preview .has-source:hover rect:not(.c-mask){stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2}
/* Source card: what kind of source, where it is, the evidence itself, then how to open it. */
.source-card{position:absolute;z-index:30;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--control-border,var(--rule-strong));border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgb(16 24 40/.16);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--secondary)}
.source-card header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}
.source-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.source-icon svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.source-head{display:grid;gap:2px;flex:1;min-width:0}
.source-card b{color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;line-height:1.4}
.source-where{font:11.5px/1.4 var(--mono);color:var(--muted);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.source-number{flex-shrink:0;min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:999px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--sunk);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.source-card pre{margin:0;max-height:280px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.6;padding:8px 0;border-radius:8px}
.source-card .line{display:block;padding:0 12px 0 0;white-space:pre}
.source-card .line i{display:inline-block;width:3.2em;padding-right:10px;text-align:right;color:var(--faint);font-style:normal;user-select:none}
.source-note{margin:0;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--sunk);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--rule-strong);line-height:1.6}
.source-note span{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.source-card footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:8px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.source-pin code{font-size:11px}
.source-card a{font-size:12px;font-weight:500}
@media print{.source-card{display:none!important}}

/* Follow-up questions */
.ask-button{margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;font-size:12px;padding:1px 9px;color:var(--muted);border-color:transparent;background:none;opacity:.7;transition:opacity .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s}
.panel:hover .ask-button,.ask-button:focus-visible{opacity:1;border-color:var(--rule-strong)}
.ask-button:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 40%,var(--rule))}
.ask-floating{position:absolute;z-index:20;font-size:12px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);border:0;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgb(0 0 0/.18)}
.ask-floating:hover{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
/* Follow-up dialog: where the question points, suggested questions, the reader's words, then copy. */
.ask-dialog{width:min(560px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:0;border-radius:14px}
.ask-dialog form{margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;padding:20px 22px 18px}
.ask-dialog header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.ask-dialog h2{font:600 16px/1.35 var(--sans);color:var(--ink)}
.ask-where{margin-top:3px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.ask-close{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;width:28px;height:28px;margin:-3px -5px 0 0;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:none;color:var(--faint);transition:background .15s,color .15s}
.ask-close:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 6%,transparent);color:var(--ink)}
.ask-close:focus{outline:none}
.ask-close:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
.ask-close svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round}
.ask-dialog blockquote{margin:0;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--sunk);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--secondary);max-height:120px;overflow:auto}
.ask-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.ask-chips button{height:28px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong);border-radius:999px;background:var(--panel);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1;color:var(--secondary);transition:background .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s}
.ask-chips button:hover{color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 45%,var(--rule))}
.ask-chips button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent-soft);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 55%,var(--rule));color:var(--accent-ink)}
.ask-dialog textarea{min-height:96px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule-strong);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;resize:vertical;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.ask-dialog textarea::placeholder{color:var(--faint)}
.ask-dialog textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 18%,transparent);background:var(--panel)}
.ask-dialog footer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0}
.ask-note{flex:1;min-width:0;margin-right:8px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted)}
.ask-dialog footer button{background:var(--panel);color:var(--secondary)}
.ask-dialog footer button:hover{background:var(--sunk);color:var(--ink)}
.ask-dialog .primary,.ask-dialog .primary:hover{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.ask-dialog .primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
.ask-dialog .primary kbd{margin-left:2px;font:500 10.5px/1 var(--sans);opacity:.75}
:root[data-theme=dark] .ask-dialog .primary{color:#0c0d10}
@media(max-width:560px){.ask-note{flex-basis:100%;margin:0 0 4px}.ask-dialog footer{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}}
@media print{.ask-button,.ask-floating{display:none!important}}

/* Dialogs */
dialog{color:var(--ink);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgb(0 0 0/.25)}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgb(10 10 12/.55);backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
/* The interactive view fills the window: the Viewer brings its own title and tools, so the dialog
   adds no bar of its own, only a close control on the backdrop above it. */
.viewer-dialog{width:min(1440px,calc(100vw - 48px));height:calc(100dvh - 76px);max-height:none;margin:56px auto 20px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgb(0 0 0/.45),0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255/.06)}
.viewer-dialog[open]{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.viewer-dialog::backdrop{background:rgb(8 10 15/.72);backdrop-filter:blur(8px) saturate(.85)}
.viewer-dialog h2{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}
.viewer-close{position:fixed;top:12px;right:max(24px,calc((100vw - 1440px) / 2));display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;height:34px;padding:0 8px 0 12px;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255/.16);border-radius:999px;background:rgb(255 255 255/.1);color:#fff;font-size:13px;line-height:1;transition:background .15s}
.viewer-close:hover{background:rgb(255 255 255/.18)}
.viewer-close:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px}
.viewer-close .tool-icon{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round}
.viewer-close kbd{padding:3px 6px;border-radius:5px;background:rgb(255 255 255/.14);font:500 10.5px/1 var(--sans);color:rgb(255 255 255/.8)}
.viewer-dialog iframe{width:100%;flex:1;border:0;min-height:0}
.dialog-loading{margin:auto;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.dialog-loading[hidden]{display:none}
.dialog-open{overflow:hidden}
#toast{position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:8px 15px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:100}
#toast.visible{opacity:1}

/* Styles. Clean is the default; editorial, product and swiss restyle the same structure. Each has a
   light palette and a screen-only dark palette, so print always uses the light one. */
:root[data-style=editorial]{--paper:#f6f2ea;--panel:#fbf8f2;--surface:#fbf8f2;--sunk:#f1ece2;--zebra:#f3eee5;--code:#f1ece2;--ink:#1d1a16;--secondary:#3a352e;--muted:#7a7166;--faint:#a39a8e;--rule:#e4dccf;--rule-strong:#d4c9b8;--accent:#9c2f1f;--accent-soft:#f4e6df;--accent-ink:#86261a;--marker:#f0d9cf;--badge:#1d1a16;--badge-ink:#fbf8f2;--shadow:none;--serif:"Songti SC","Noto Serif SC","Source Han Serif SC",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
:root[data-style=product]{--paper:#f3f4f8;--panel:#fff;--surface:#fff;--sunk:#f5f6fb;--zebra:#f7f8fc;--code:#f5f6fb;--ink:#0b0d12;--secondary:#272b35;--muted:#626a7b;--faint:#99a0ae;--rule:#e7e9f0;--rule-strong:#d7dbe6;--accent:#5b4bf5;--accent-soft:#f1efff;--accent-ink:#4a3be0;--marker:#e4e0ff;--badge:#5b4bf5;--badge-ink:#fff;--shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40/.04),0 8px 24px rgb(16 24 40/.06)}
:root[data-style=swiss]{--control-border:#d4d4d4;--paper:#fff;--panel:#fff;--surface:#fff;--sunk:#f4f4f4;--zebra:#f7f7f7;--code:#f4f4f4;--ink:#000;--secondary:#1f1f1f;--muted:#6b6b6b;--faint:#a0a0a0;--rule:#e6e6e6;--rule-strong:#000;--accent:#ff4f00;--accent-soft:#fff0e8;--accent-ink:#d94300;--marker:#ffe0cf;--badge:#000;--badge-ink:#fff;--shadow:none}
@media screen{
:root[data-style=editorial][data-theme=dark]{--paper:#171512;--panel:#1d1a16;--surface:#1d1a16;--sunk:#24211c;--zebra:#211e19;--code:#24211c;--ink:#f2ece2;--secondary:#d8d0c4;--muted:#a1978a;--faint:#6f675d;--rule:#2e2a24;--rule-strong:#3d372f;--accent:#e0806b;--accent-soft:#2e1d18;--accent-ink:#f0a08c;--marker:#4a2a20;--badge:#f2ece2;--badge-ink:#171512}
:root[data-style=product][data-theme=dark]{--paper:#0d0e14;--panel:#161824;--surface:#161824;--sunk:#1c1f2e;--zebra:#1a1c29;--code:#1c1f2e;--ink:#f2f3f8;--secondary:#cfd2de;--muted:#8e93a8;--faint:#5d6278;--rule:#262a3b;--rule-strong:#333850;--accent:#8d80ff;--accent-soft:#211e40;--accent-ink:#b3aaff;--marker:#2f2a5c;--badge:#8d80ff;--badge-ink:#0d0e14;--shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.4)}
:root[data-style=swiss][data-theme=dark]{--control-border:#363636;--paper:#0a0a0a;--panel:#0a0a0a;--surface:#0a0a0a;--sunk:#161616;--zebra:#121212;--code:#161616;--ink:#fff;--secondary:#e6e6e6;--muted:#9a9a9a;--faint:#5c5c5c;--rule:#262626;--rule-strong:#fff;--accent:#ff6a1f;--accent-soft:#2a1508;--accent-ink:#ff8a4d;--marker:#4a2410;--badge:#fff;--badge-ink:#000}

ms，平均值只涨约 8 ms。\n- 尾部恶化几乎总是某一部分请求出问题，不是接口整体变慢。\n- 顺序原则：先定位慢在哪一段，再按维度切分，最后对照变更和资源。\n\n@answer scope=\"数值为示意 · 假设常见 Web/微服务接口 · P99 按第 990/1000 个值计\"\n@meta locale=zh-CN\n\n## 为什么平均值没动？       const preview = block.querySelector('.diagram-preview');
      const button = document.createElement('button'); button.type = 'button'; button.className = 'walk-start'; button.textContent = `▶ ${words.walkFlow}`; button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
      block.querySelector('.diagram-title')?.after(button);
      button.addEventListener('click',()=>walk(button,nodes,index=>{
        if (index < 0) { spotlight(preview); return; }
        const node = nodes[index], into = edges.filter(edge=>edge.to === node.id && (index === 0 || nodes.slice(0,index).some(seen=>seen.id === edge.from)));
        spotlight(preview,[node.id,...into.map(edge=>edge.from)],into.map(edge=>edge.id));
        const target = preview.querySelector(`[data-node-id="${CSS.escape(node.id)}"]`), box = target?.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (box && (box.top < 0 || box.bottom > innerHeight - 80)) target.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'smooth'});
        return node.label || node.id;
      }));
    });
    all('.block-diagram').forEach(block=>{
      if (diagrams[block.id]?.diagramType !== 'sequence') return;
      const preview = block.querySelector('.diagram-preview'), messages = all('[data-edge-id]',preview);
      if (messages.length < 2) return;
      const button = document.createElement('button'); button.type = 'button'; button.className = 'walk-start'; button.textContent = `▶ ${words.walkMessages}`; button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
      block.querySelector('.diagram-title')?.after(button);
      const label = id => preview.querySelector(`[data-node-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`)?.dataset.nodeLabel || id;
      button.addEventListener('click',()=>walk(button,messages,index=>{
        if (index < 0) { spotlight(preview); return; }
        const message = messages[index];
        spotlight(preview,[message.dataset.edgeFrom,message.dataset.edgeTo],[message.dataset.edgeId]);
        const box = message.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (box.top < 0 || box.bottom > innerHeight - 80) message.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'smooth'});
        return `${label(message.dataset.edgeFrom)} → ${label(message.dataset.edgeTo)}${say(': ','：')}${message.dataset.edgeLabel || ''}`;
      }));
    });
  }
  all('[data-copy]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const text = button.closest('figure').querySelector('pre code').textContent;
    Promise.resolve(navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text)).then(()=>{button.textContent = words.copied;setTimeout(()=>{button.textContent = words.copy;},1600);},()=>notify(say('Copy failed.','复制失败。')));
  }));
  // Follow-up questions: a reader asks about a panel, or about selected text in it, and copies a
  // message that names the page, the panel ID and the quote, so the agent can revise just that panel.
  function setupAsk() {
    const dialog = document.createElement('dialog'); dialog.className = 'ask-dialog';
    const mac = /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent);
    dialog.innerHTML = `<form method="dialog"><header><div><h2 id="ask-title">${words.ask}</h2><p class="ask-where"></p></div><button type="button" class="ask-close" data-ask-cancel aria-label="${words.askCancel}"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 4l8 8M12 4l-8 8"/></svg></button></header><blockquote hidden></blockquote><div class="ask-chips" role="group" aria-label="${words.askQuestion}">${words.askChips.map(chip=>`<button type="button" data-chip>${chip}</button>`).join('')}</div><textarea rows="4" aria-labelledby="ask-title" placeholder="${words.askPlaceholder}"></textarea><footer><p class="ask-note">${words.askNote}</p><button type="button" data-ask-cancel>${words.askCancel}</button><button type="submit" class="primary">${words.askCopy}<kbd>${mac ? '⌘↵' : 'Ctrl ↵'}</kbd></button></footer></form>`;
    document.body.append(dialog);
    const area = dialog.querySelector('textarea'), quoteBox = dialog.querySelector('blockquote');
    let context = null;
    const open = (panel, quote = '') => {
      const number = panel.id === 'answer' ? words.answer : panel.querySelector('.panel-id')?.textContent.trim();
      const title = panel.id === 'answer' ? words.answer : panel.dataset.title || panel.querySelector('h2')?.textContent.trim();
      context = {panel,quote,number,title};
      dialog.querySelector('.ask-where').textContent = panel.id === 'answer' ? title : say(`Panel ${number} · ${title}`,`面板 ${number} · ${title}`);
      all('[data-chip]',dialog).forEach(chip=>chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'));
      quoteBox.hidden = !quote; quoteBox.textContent = quote;
      area.value = ''; dialog.showModal(); area.focus();
    };
    // A suggested question is added once; choosing it again takes it back out.
    dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-chip]').forEach(chip=>chip.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const lines = area.value.split('\n').filter(line=>line.trim()), on = !lines.includes(chip.textContent);
      area.value = (on ? [...lines,chip.textContent] : lines.filter(line=>line !== chip.textContent)).join('\n');
      chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on)); area.focus();
    }));
    area.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{ if (event.key === 'Enter' && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) { event.preventDefault(); dialog.querySelector('form').requestSubmit(); } });
    dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-ask-cancel]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>dialog.close()));
    dialog.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      const {panel,quote,number,title} = context, page = document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent.trim();
      const file = location.protocol === 'file:' ? decodeURIComponent(location.pathname) : location.href.split('#')[0];
      const quoteMark = text => english ? `"${text}"` : `「${text}」`;
      const lines = [
        `${words.askPage}${say(': ','：')}${quoteMark(page)}`,
        `${words.askFile}${say(': ','：')}${file}`,
        `${words.askWhere}${say(': ','：')}${panel.id === 'answer' ? title : say(`Panel ${number} ${quoteMark(title)}`,`面板 ${number}${quoteMark(title)}`)}${say(` (ID: ${panel.id})`,`（ID: ${panel.id}）`)}`,
        ...(quote ? [`${words.askQuoteLabel}${say(': ','：')}${quoteMark(quote)}`] : []),
        `${words.askQuestion}${say(': ','：')}${area.value.trim() || words.askChips[0]}`,
        ...(panel.id === 'answer' ? [] : [words.askPatch]),
      ];
      const text = lines.join('\n');
      Promise.resolve(navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text)).then(()=>{ dialog.close(); notify(words.askCopied); },()=>{ area.value = text; area.select(); });
    });
    all('.panel').forEach(panel=>{
      const button = document.createElement('button'); button.type = 'button'; button.className = 'ask-button interactive'; button.textContent = words.ask;
      button.addEventListener('click',()=>open(panel));
      panel.querySelector('.panel-head')?.append(button);
    });
    const floating = document.createElement('button'); floating.type = 'button'; floating.className = 'ask-floating'; floating.textContent = words.askQuote; floating.hidden = true;
    document.body.append(floating);
    let selected = null;
    document.addEventListener('selectionchange',()=>{
      const selection = getSelection(), text = selection.toString().replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
      const panel = selection.rangeCount ? selection.getRangeAt(0).commonAncestorContainer.parentElement?.closest?.('.panel') || (selection.getRangeAt(0).commonAncestorContainer.closest?.('.panel')) : null;
      if (!panel || text.length < 2 || dialog.open) { floating.hidden = true; selected = null; return; }
      const box = selection.getRangeAt(0).getBoundingClientRect();
      selected = {panel,text:text.slice(0,400)};
      floating.style.left = `${Math.max(8,Math.min(innerWidth - 120,box.left + box.width / 2 - 45 + scrollX))}px`;
      floating.style.top = `${box.top + scrollY - 38}px`;
      floating.hidden = false;
    });
    floating.addEventListener('mousedown',event=>event.preventDefault());
    floating.addEventListener('click',()=>{ if (selected) open(selected.panel,selected.text); floating.hidden = true; });
  }
  // Source cards: hovering or focusing a citation shows where the claim comes from, with the pinned
  // code excerpt for a repository source, so a reader can check it without leaving the page.
  const glyph = path => `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="${path}"/></svg>`;
  const sourceIcons = {
    code:glyph('M5.5 5 2.5 8l3 3M10.5 5l3 3-3 3M9 3.5 7 12.5'),
    web:glyph('M8 2a6 6 0 1 0 0 12A6 6 0 0 0 8 2zM2 8h12M8 2c1.7 1.6 2.5 3.6 2.5 6S9.7 12.4 8 14C6.3 12.4 5.5 10.4 5.5 8S6.3 3.6 8 2z'),
    note:glyph('M4 2.5h5.5l2.5 2.5v8.5H4zM9.5 2.5V5H12M6 8h4M6 10.5h4'),
  };
  function setupSourceCards() {
    const sources = prepared.preparedSources?.sources || {};
    const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = 'source-card'; card.hidden = true; card.setAttribute('role','tooltip');
    document.body.append(card);
    let hideTimer;
    const hide = () => { hideTimer = setTimeout(()=>{ card.hidden = true; },160); };
    card.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>clearTimeout(hideTimer)); card.addEventListener('mouseleave',hide);
    const show = (link, id = decodeURIComponent(link.getAttribute('href').slice('#source-'.length))) => {
      const source = sources[id] || prepared.document?.sources?.find(entry=>entry.id === id);
      if (!source) return;
      clearTimeout(hideTimer);
      const escapeText = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g,character=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[character]));
      // A repository source shows its pinned excerpt; a web page its host; any other note its text.
      const host = (()=>{ try { return new URL(source.url).host.replace(/^www\./,''); } catch { return ''; } })();
      const where = source.path ? `${source.path}${source.lines ? `:${source.lines.join('–')}` : ''}` : host;
      const kind = source.path ? 'code' : source.url ? 'web' : 'note';
      const lines = source.path && typeof source.text === 'string' ? source.text.split('\n') : [];
      const first = source.lines?.[0] || 1;
      const excerpt = lines.length ? `<pre><code>${lines.slice(0,14).map((line,index)=>`<span class="line"><i>${first + index}</i>${escapeText(line) || ' '}</span>`).join('')}${lines.length > 14 ? `<span class="line more"><i></i>…</span>` : ''}</code></pre>` : '';
      const note = !source.path && (source.text || source.method) ? `<p class="source-note">${escapeText(source.text || '')}${source.method ? `<span>${escapeText(source.method)}</span>` : ''}</p>` : '';
      const number = /^\d+$/.test(link.textContent.trim()) ? link.textContent.trim() : '';
      card.innerHTML = `<header><span class="source-icon" data-kind="${kind}" aria-hidden="true">${sourceIcons[kind]}</span><span class="source-head"><b>${escapeText(source.title || source.path || id)}</b>${where ? `<span class="source-where">${escapeText(where)}</span>` : ''}</span>${number ? `<span class="source-number">${number}</span>` : ''}</header>${excerpt}${note}${source.revision || source.url ? `<footer>${source.revision ? `<span class="source-pin">${say('Pinned at','固定在')} <code>${escapeText(String(source.revision).slice(0,7))}</code></span>` : '<span></span>'}${source.url ? `<a href="${escapeText(source.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${say('Open source','打开原文')} ↗</a>` : ''}</footer>` : ''}`;
      card.hidden = false;
      const box = link.getBoundingClientRect(), width = Math.min(520,innerWidth - 24);
      card.style.width = `${width}px`;
      card.style.left = `${Math.max(12,Math.min(innerWidth - width - 12,box.left - 24)) + scrollX}px`;
      const below = box.bottom + 8 + card.offsetHeight < innerHeight;
      card.style.top = `${(below ? box.bottom + 8 : box.top - 8 - card.offsetHeight) + scrollY}px`;
    };
    all('.cite a[href^="#source-"]').forEach(link=>{
      link.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>show(link)); link.addEventListener('focus',()=>show(link));
      link.addEventListener('mouseleave',hide); link.addEventListener('blur',hide);
    });
    // A diagram node tied to a source opens the same card, so a code diagram doubles as a code tour.
    all('.diagram-preview[data-node-sources]').forEach(preview=>{
      let map = {}; try { map = JSON.parse(preview.dataset.nodeSources); } catch {}
      all('[data-node-id]',preview).forEach(node=>{
        const id = map[node.dataset.nodeId]; if (!id) return;
        node.classList.add('has-source');
        node.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>show(node,id)); node.addEventListener('mouseleave',hide);
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{ if (event.key === 'Escape') card.hidden = true; });
  }
  // Checklist ticks are the reader's own progress; keep them per page and block across reloads.
  all('.checklist').forEach(list=>{
    const key = `archify-checklist:${root.dataset.artifact}:${list.closest('.block').id}`, boxes = all('input',list);
    let saved = []; try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '[]'); } catch {}
    boxes.forEach((box,index)=>{ box.checked = saved[index] === 1; box.addEventListener('change',()=>{ try { localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(boxes.map(b=>b.checked ? 1 : 0))); } catch {} }); });
  });
  // Native dialogs supply Escape, focus trapping and the accessible modal semantics.
  const printDetails = new Map();
  all('.diagram-semantics').forEach(details=>details.open = false);
  window.addEventListener('beforeprint',()=>all('.diagram-semantics').forEach(details=>{printDetails.set(details,details.open);details.open = true;}));
  window.addEventListener('afterprint',()=>{printDetails.forEach((open,details)=>details.open = open);printDetails.clear();});
  root.classList.add('js');
  applyTheme();
  cropDiagramPreviews();
  linkTerms();
  setupWalks();
  setupAsk();
  setupSourceCards();
  layoutBoard();
  const relayout = () => { layoutBoard(); ensureDiagramReadability(); };
  Promise.resolve(document.fonts?.ready).then(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(relayout)));
  let resizeFrame;
  window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(resizeFrame);resizeFrame = requestAnimationFrame(relayout);});
})();
</script></body></html>
